request.deadline: 12 months after deployment, with month-6 yield distribution
deliverables: Deploy treasury-owned capital into Strike Finance V2 USDM liquidity infrastructure
Return realized yield from the first six months to the Cardano Treasury at month 6
Return 100% of treasury-owned deployed assets, including remaining principal and realized yield, at month 12
Provide monthly public transparency reports covering deployment, utilization, volume, P&L, yield, drawdown, stablecoin exposure, market quality, distributions, and material risks
Provide third-party assurance reports at deployment confirmation, month 6, and month 12
request.recipient: Independent council administering Strike Finance liquidity deployment
request.what: 12-month productive treasury deployment into Strike Finance V2 liquidity infrastructure, with ADA sold for USDM to provide stablecoin-denominated liquidity and returned with realized yield.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 9,000,000 ADA for a 12-month liquidity deployment, not grant funding, with treasury ownership retained throughout deployment.
The deployed ADA will be sold for USDM, modeled at ADA = 0.15 USD to produce approximately 1,350,000 USDM of stablecoin liquidity.
The deployment is modeled to generate approximately 900,000 ADA-equivalent in annual yield at a 10% USD-denominated APR, but returns are not guaranteed.

Strike reports more than 1.13 billion USD in cumulative volume, about 968,000 to 1,001,000 trades, more than 3,000 unique traders, more than 1.16 million USD protocol revenue, and more than 3.25 million USD liquidity provider profit.
Strike V2 data from 2026-03-20 through 2026-06-15 is presented as showing accelerating volume, revenue, trades, users, and open interest as liquidity deepened.

The Strike Liquidity Provider vault is described as having about 985,271.59 USD TVL, 43.52% APR, +8.85% all-time return, 1.15% maximum drawdown, 4.97 Sharpe ratio, and 208 depositors after two months.

An independent multisig council composed of Rami from Snek, Phil from Surf, and James from Monetra or Moneta will administer custody and prevent Strike Finance from having unilateral control of treasury assets.

The proposal identifies risks including ADA price appreciation underperformance, USDM depeg or redemption risk, smart contract risk, yield underperformance, custody risk, and operational multisig risk.

Governance review is triggered if drawdown exceeds 8%, reporting is missed for two consecutive monthly cycles, or unresolved custody, accounting, stablecoin, redemption, or smart contract concerns arise, with mandatory review at 10% drawdown and a separate wind-down review above 20% drawdown.
The proposal states Strike V2 has had unofficial technical reviews and that an official audit by Christian Schmitz is expected to be finalized by July 1, 2026, with publication upon completion.

summary: The document proposes a temporary 9,000,000 ADA treasury-owned liquidity deployment into Strike Finance V2 via USDM, with modeled yield, multisig administration, reporting, assurance, risk triggers, and final return of principal plus realized yield, while relying heavily on proposer-stated traction and vault performance figures.
